meta.name: igce-builder-ffp
meta.description: Build IGCEs for Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) federal contracts using structured wrap rate buildup (fringe, overhead, G&A, profit). Orchestrates BLS OEWS, GSA CALC+, and GSA Per Diem skills. Supports FFP-by-period and FFP-by-deliverable pricing structures, SOW/PWS decomposition into labor categories, and rate validation against CALC+ market data. Trigger for: FFP IGCE, firm fixed price estimate, firm fixed price cost estimate, wrap rate, wrap rate buildup, cost buildup, FFP cost model, build an FFP IGCE, price this FFP contract, fixed price estimate, FFP from this SOW. Also trigger for wrap rate analysis, implied multiplier, FFP scenario analysis, or FFP rate comparison. Do NOT use for Labor Hour, T&M, or cost-reimbursement IGCEs (use IGCE Builder LH/T&M or IGCE Builder CR). Do NOT use for grant budgets (use Grant Budget Builder). Requires the bls-oews, gsa-calc, and gsa-perdiem MCP servers.

copy.tagline: 为固定价格联邦合同构建成本估算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为FFP联邦合同编制详细的成本加价估算
copy.tagline_en: Build cost estimates for firm-fixed-price federal contracts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build detailed wrap rate cost estimates for FFP federal contracts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你为固定价格（FFP）联邦合同构建独立政府成本估算（IGCE）。它会按步骤收集人工类别、地点、人数等信息，调用BLS工资、GSA CALC+费率等数据，生成包含附加费率（福利、管理费、利润）的成本模型。
howto.when: 当你提出“FFP IGCE”、“固定价格估算”、“wrap rate buildup”等关键词，或要求从SOW/PWS构建FFP估算时触发。不适用于工时、T&M或成本报销类合同。

say.text: 帮我为华盛顿DC的软件开发人员做一个FFP IGCE。
say.note: Claude会收集所需信息并开始构建估算。

say.text: 从这份SOW构建一个FFP成本估算。
say.note: Claude会先分解SOW为人工类别，再执行完整流程。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you build Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCE) for Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) federal contracts. It collects labor categories, location, staffing, etc., calls BLS wages, GSA CALC+ rates, and generates a cost model with wrap rates (fringe, overhead, G&A, profit).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'FFP IGCE', 'firm fixed price estimate', 'wrap rate buildup', or ask to build an FFP IGCE from a SOW/PWS. Not for Labor Hour, T&M, or cost-reimbursement contracts.

say_en.text: Build an FFP IGCE for a software developer in Washington DC.
say_en.note: Claude will collect required inputs and start building.

say_en.text: Build an FFP cost estimate from this SOW.
say_en.note: Claude will decompose the SOW into labor categories first.
